confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result: the 18 Nov 2026 observation was 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors rest on one price search of cost-of-living aggregates, which are crowdsourced and partly dated. Those showed a domestic beer of about CHF 7, a cappuccino of about CHF 5.2, an inexpensive meal of about CHF 25-45 and a mid-range main course of about CHF 38. I found no cocktail price. The cocktail figure is estimated at about 2x the beer price, and the wine glass figure assumes about 1.5-2 dl of house wine at a restaurant. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no listings searched. They are uncertain, especially for the peak July season. I used CHF 1 ≈ USD 1.25 to convert the CHF figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lucerne is a high-cost Swiss tourist city, with prices similar to Zurich and slightly below it. Restaurant prices were taken from Lucerne-specific cost-of-living data.
